name: The Sheriff of Nottingham

crownPassive.name: Taxed
crownPassive.text: At the start of the fight, take one item at random from your opponent's belt into a fourth item slot of yours. If they brought no items, nothing happens.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Wanted
actions.text: Mark an enemy card. Every attack on it this round deals +1 damage.

actions.name: Break their spirit
actions.text: Attack an enemy hero. It loses all Guard, printed and bonus, and can't gain Guard for the rest of the fight.

notes: Speed 4 so his mark lands before most of your other attacks. Taxed: the opponent is told they have been taxed by the Sheriff of Nottingham and sees the item float across the board into the Sheriff's belt.
